items.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
items.summary: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

items.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
items.summary: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.summary: Local officials say more had been missing after at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a village in southern Ukraine.

items.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
items.summary: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground!"

items.title: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
items.summary: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities. BBC Verify has used air traffic control audio and flight tracking data to reconstruct the final moments before the plane crashed.

items.title: MP Carla Lockhart quits DUP in Drumcree row
items.summary: Lockhart had called for the DUP to remove First Minister Michelle O'Neill from office.

items.title: Two boys arrested after Halloween party stabbings
items.summary: Two teenage boys, both from Southampton, have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder.

items.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
items.summary: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.
